Chapter 206 0203 The On-site Spectacle

Holding the esports finals in the northern winter was a very stupid thing to do.

The second time around would definitely have to be changed!

It would be changed to holding qualifying rounds in the spring, then the offline finals during summer break.

Among those who came to Beijing for the competition this time were also various cosplayers.

Chen Guiliang had originally planned to let players sign up freely, but the cost of cosplay was too high, and applicants were few and far between. So, he simply invited professional cosplayers for a commercial performance.

Although they were called professionals, they were really running on passion.

The pay from commercial gigs was often not enough to cover the cost of making their props.

"Wow, the client is so generous this time!"

"Indeed. Not many are willing to reimburse travel expenses, let alone provide free hotel stays."

"Youke is pretty formidable after all."

"We should be able to break even this time."

The members of the 304 cosplay group were quite excited when they arrived at the hotel.

They were mostly university students, with some who had just recently entered the workforce.

The team leader, Zhang Yu, had graduated with a bachelor's degree six months ago, but he had been in the 304 group for a full four years. When traveling for events, staying in unfurnished apartments and eating instant noodles was the norm. Being able to stay in a hotel was an unexpected pleasure.

"Huang Shan! You're here too?"

"Haha, long time no see. I'm cosplaying Sima Yi and Lu Xun this time. Xiao Meng and the others came too, they're staying on this floor."

"All the famous domestic cosplayers are gathered here? They've really put on a big show."

Suddenly, a staff member from ByteDance appeared, holding a laptop.

The staff member went around asking which of the cosplayers had a Kaixin001 account. If they didn't, they could register for one in the hotel and would be gifted with Kaixin001 site currency.

Kaixin001 also activated the mobile Weibo function for all the cosplayers and helped them prepay for a three-month subscription plan.

The cosplayers were overjoyed upon hearing this. It would be foolish not to take advantage of such a good offer!

After settling things here, the staff member went to the room of the "Game Scrim" host.

"Hello, I'm Lou Kai from ByteDance."

"Hello."

Lou Kai asked, "Excuse me, do you have a Kaixin001 account?"

The host, Zhang Hongsheng, shook his head. "Uh… no."

Lou Kai introduced, "Our Kaixin001 is China's largest SNS platform. We already have several million registered users and over a hundred celebrities from all walks of life have joined. Li Ao writes articles here, Yu Quan, Hu Ge, Zhang Liangying, Han Han, and others often post on Weibo… You can build your fanbase on Kaixin001. We can also activate mobile Weibo for you and prepay for a three-month subscription plan."

Lou Kai turned on the laptop screen and clicked open the homepages of more than a dozen celebrities, showing Zhang Hongsheng their follower counts.
